			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_command_max = 25 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_org = 0.05 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = hof_ma_idea_joint_command } } add_ideas = hof_ma_idea_joint_command }
		}
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_done_hof_ma_mil_joint_staff } }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_org = 0.10 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_planning = 0.10 }
		}
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_done_hof_ma_mil_political_consultative } }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_war_support = 0.10 }
		}
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_done_hof_ma_mil_standing_bodies } }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_command = 0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_org = 0.05 }
		}
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_done_hof_ma_mil_integrated_units } }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_attack = 0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_conscription = 0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_manpower = 250 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_fuel = 0.10 }
		}
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_done_hof_ma_mil_unified_equipment } }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_supply = -0.10 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_production = 0.10 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_equip_xp = -0.10 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_fuel = 0.10 }
		}
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_done_hof_ma_mil_air_defence } }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_aa = 0.15 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_air_dmg = -0.15 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_defence = 0.05 }
		}
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_done_hof_ma_mil_joint_exercises } }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_org = 0.10 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_planning = 0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_attrition = -0.10 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_training = -0.10 }
		}
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_done_hof_ma_mil_doctrine } }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_attack = 0.10 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_breakthrough = 0.05 }
		}
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_done_hof_ma_mil_officer_training } }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_conscription = 0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_manpower = 250 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_training = -0.10 }
		}
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_done_hof_ma_mil_licensed_production } }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_production = 0.15 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_equip_xp = -0.10 }
		}
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_done_hof_ma_mil_defence_ministers } }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_command = 0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_command_max = 25 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_planning = 0.05 }
		}
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_done_hof_ma_mil_committees } }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_supply = -0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_supply_cap = 0.10 }
		}
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_done_hof_ma_mil_mbfr } }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_war_support = 0.05 }
		}
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_done_hof_ma_mil_csce } }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_defence = 0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_war_support = 0.05 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = hof_ma_idea_csce } } add_ideas = hof_ma_idea_csce }
		}
		if = { limit = { SOV = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_done_hof_ma_mil_nuclear } }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_attack = 0.15 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_defence = 0.10 }
			add_to_variable = { hof_ma_mil_breakthrough = 0.05 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = hof_ma_idea_nuclear_umbrella } } add_ideas = hof_ma_idea_nuclear_umbrella }
		}
	}
}

hof_ma_reconcile_all = {
	every_country = {
		if = { limit = { hof_ma_eligible = yes } hof_ma_reconcile_member = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_joined NOT = { hof_ma_eligible = yes } } hof_ma_clear_member = yes }
	}
}

hof_ma_distribute_resource_hof_ma_eco_ibec = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = hof_ma_resource_done_hof_ma_eco_ibec }
			OR = {
				has_focus_tree = argentine_focus_tree
				has_focus_tree = australia_taog_focus
				has_focus_tree = brazil_tree
				has_focus_tree = brazilian_focus
				has_focus_tree = china_communist_focus_sea
				has_focus_tree = cuban_focus
				has_focus_tree = danish_focus
				has_focus_tree = estonia_tree
				has_focus_tree = ethiopia_tree
				has_focus_tree = finnish_focus
				has_focus_tree = french_focus
				has_focus_tree = hon_focus
				has_focus_tree = iceland_tree
				has_focus_tree = latvia_tree
				has_focus_tree = lithuania_tree
				has_focus_tree = Mongolia_focus
				has_focus_tree = norwegian_focus
				has_focus_tree = philippines_focus
				has_focus_tree = polish_focus
				has_focus_tree = r56_afghanistan_focus
				has_focus_tree = saudi_focus
				has_focus_tree = siam_focus
				has_focus_tree = soviet_focus
				has_focus_tree = sweden_focus
				has_focus_tree = tuva_focus
				has_focus_tree = wuw_hungarian_focus
			}
		}
		capital_scope = { add_resource = { type = oil amount = 20 } add_resource = { type = aluminium amount = 20 } add_resource = { type = rubber amount = 20 } add_resource = { type = tungsten amount = 20 } add_resource = { type = steel amount = 20 } add_resource = { type = chromium amount = 20 } add_resource = { type = coal amount = 20 } }
		set_country_flag = hof_ma_resource_done_hof_ma_eco_ibec
	}
}
